# AutoTracker

AutoTracker is a Gmail-first order tracking service for consumers who want to follow online purchases and deliveries from one dashboard.

## What the product does
AutoTracker reads order confirmation and shipping emails from Gmail, extracts order details, and surfaces tracking information in a simple dashboard for the user.

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://app-autotracker.vercel.app/
- Privacy Policy: https://app-autotracker.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://app-autotracker.vercel.app/terms
- Cookie Policy: https://app-autotracker.vercel.app/cookies

## Important notes
- The service is designed for personal account use and requires Google account access to read relevant order-related email content.
- The app stores structured order metadata such as merchant, tracking number, totals, and delivery status.
- Legal and privacy disclosures are published on the site and should be treated as the source of truth for consent, retention, and processor details.

## Brand and positioning
AutoTracker is positioned as a private, customer-friendly productivity and order tracking tool that reduces the friction of managing deliveries across multiple retailers.
